# Saeed Accounting

> Saeed Accounting is an FTA-registered accounting, VAT, and corporate tax consultancy based in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. It serves mainland and free zone businesses across the UAE with 30 years of combined team experience, offering accounting, tax compliance, and business setup support.

Saeed Accounting positions itself as a certified tax consultant helping UAE businesses stay compliant with FTA (Federal Tax Authority) regulations. Services span day-to-day bookkeeping and accounts management, full VAT lifecycle support (registration through de-registration), corporate tax registration and filing, and business setup support such as local sponsorship and PRO services. The firm emphasizes personalized advice, fast turnaround (e.g. same-week corporate tax filing), and ongoing WhatsApp-based client communication.

- [Home](https://saeedaccounting.com/): Overview of the firm, services, team stats, and client reviews.

## Accounting services

- [Accounts Receivable Services](https://saeedaccounting.com/accounts-receivable-services): Managing and tracking customer payments owed to a business.
- [Accounts Payable Services](https://saeedaccounting.com/accounts-payable-services): Managing and processing payments owed to suppliers and vendors.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://saeedaccounting.com/accounting-bookkeeping): Recording, classifying, and summarizing financial transactions.
- [CFO Services](https://saeedaccounting.com/cfo-services): Strategic financial leadership without a full-time in-house CFO.

## VAT / Tax services

- [VAT Registration](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-registration): Registering businesses with UAE tax authorities.
- [VAT Return Filing](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-return-filling): Preparing and submitting VAT returns within deadlines.
- [VAT De-Registration](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-de-registration): Removing a business from the VAT system when no longer required.
- [VAT Audit](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-audit): Reviewing VAT records and compliance.
- [VAT Refund](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-refund): Assistance recovering eligible VAT refunds.
- [VAT Amendment](https://saeedaccounting.com/vat-amendment): Updating or correcting VAT registration details.

## Corporate Tax services

- [Corporate Tax Registration](https://saeedaccounting.com/corporate-tax-registration): Registering businesses for UAE corporate tax.
- [Corporate Tax Filing](https://saeedaccounting.com/corporate-tax-filing): Preparing and submitting corporate tax returns.
- [Corporate Tax Implementation](https://saeedaccounting.com/corporate-tax-implementation): Setting up processes and systems for corporate tax compliance.
- [Corporate Tax Advisory](https://saeedaccounting.com/corporate-tax-advisory): Strategic guidance on corporate tax matters.

## Support services

- [Business Formation](https://saeedaccounting.com/business-formation): Guidance through legally establishing a new business entity in the UAE.
- [Local Sponsor](https://saeedaccounting.com/local-sponsor): Local sponsorship arrangements for foreign entrepreneurs in the UAE.
- [PRO Services](https://saeedaccounting.com/pro-services): Government documentation and administrative process support.
